annotations.title: EIP-712 Typed Data & Uniswap Permit2 Phishing Signature Decoder

description: Decodes EIP-712 and Uniswap Permit2 off-chain typed-data payloads to verify spender identity, detect unlimited (uint256.max) token approvals, and flag expired deadlines. Use when inspecting an off-chain eth_signTypedData_v4 or Permit2 payload before signing; for decoding raw on-chain hex transaction calldata (0x...) for eth_sendTransaction, use simulate_evm_transaction_calldata instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'typed_data_json' ('chain_id' defaults to '1'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID used to verify canonical router spender addresses; defaults to '8453' (Base) when omitted.

typed_data_json.description: JSON string or object containing the EIP-712 / Permit2 message (spender, amount, deadline).

name: decode_eip712_permit_signature

spender_address.description: Normalized lowercase EVM address of the permit spender.

spender_identity.description: Identified protocol router label or 'Unknown Third-Party Spender'.

unlimited_approval_detected.description: True if the approval value equals uint256.max / uint160.max.
